question: Did the newest CIP-003 revision change what it asks of us compared with the one it replaced?
answer:
Based on the available records, the transition from **CIP-003-8** to **CIP-003-9** was driven by a FERC Order (Docket No. RD23-3-000) approved on March 16, 2023 [cite R-4cc156].

While the provided search results do not contain the full text of the requirements for both versions to perform a line-by-line comparison of the duties, the version history for the operator's **CIP Cyber Security Policy** indicates that the most recent revision (Version 13.0) was updated to include "references to CIP-003-9" [cite O-bfb9c5].

I have not read the full text of the CIP-003-8 or CIP-003-9 standards to identify specific changes in thresholds, intervals, or permitted actions. If you can provide the specific requirement references or if you would like me to search for specific topics within those versions, I can perform a detailed comparison.

Quoted sources:
- "9 | 3/16/2023 | FERC Order issued approving CIP-003-9. Docket No. RD23-3-000. |" (CIP-003-9 — Version History)
- "Updated references to CIP-003-9" (CIP Cyber Security Policy V13.0 — REVISION HISTORY)
